notes: Simulation rather than Racing, and the genre's own boundary note is the reason: there is no lap and no finish condition, and the author confirmed free roaming is the entire point, which is the definition of a vehicle sim instead of a race. world-open is the shape — one contiguous city driven in whatever order the player likes, with no instanced areas and no personal plot. Kept the Vehicle Sim preset and its driveable road network but dropped resource-shared, since nothing is being extracted or hauled here; added settlement-density for the present-day block grid of asphalt roads and concrete buildings the author asked for. With no user to ask I treated the buildings as facades, because the request is about driving and never mentions going inside, which keeps this off P3 and on the proven pipeline.
